title: platform skill: "Declaring is a demand" says a missing declared provider is a hard boot error, but os serve only warns for hierarchy-security
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbUb7TcZK1XUAddUmQ

Filing gate: out-of-scope note from the dev of #35171 (PR #35281 Acceptance notes), confirmed by its contract review (comment 6997435800), filed by seat 5. ⛔ Not a claim. Related, not a duplicate: #35172 (runtime fallback logs nothing outside the CLI).

## What is wrong

`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:332-334` teaches: "A capability YOU declared whose provider package is absent is a hard boot error; one the platform auto-injects for you stays best-effort (warn and continue)." `os serve` only warns for a declared `hierarchy-security` with no provider, and for cloud-only capability tokens (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:5472-5497`, the reviewer's reading on the PR head); the runtime then falls back to owner-only scope. An agent following the skill tells a user their app will refuse to boot when it will in fact start with narrowed visibility.

## Do

Read `serve.ts` and the capability preflight on main and cite them. Correct the skill line to name the exceptions (or the rule the code actually follows); if the maintainer's intent is that a declared provider is always a hard error, say so in the PR instead and leave the code question to a separate card. Pay the ratchet with a same-file restatement cut.

## Done when

The skill states what `os serve` does for a declared capability with no provider, with code cited; skill gates pass; contract review (governed `skills/**`).
